name: ModelVariant366_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant366_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the 0x18-byte command record indexed by the request, gets three slot parts, packs its texture images and sets up the effect records, otherwise it runs one frame (rays once the phase is positive, ribbons in phase 3, quads every frame, cones from phase 4) and returns 4 in phases 4-8, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in all fourteen model-363 header-366/516 and French header-383/533 images; the European, French, German, Italian and Spanish images build it through french_model_variant/variant383_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and the PAL palette x; HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
